relationships.subject: cisplatin
relationships.evidence_quote: Early-life administration of cisplatin in neonatal rats [postnatal day (P)14 and P16] induced a delayed but pronounced mechanical allodynia

relationships.subject: NGF
relationships.evidence_quote: In a rat model of early-life cisplatin-induced chronic pain, mechanical allodynia was prevented following intraperitoneal injection of the NGF-neutralising antibody

key_findings: Early-life cisplatin drives macrophage infiltration and NGF upregulation in DRG, sensitising TRPV1 nociceptors and causing mechanical allodynia.
NGF-neutralising antibody prevented cisplatin-induced nociceptor sensitisation, allodynia and CGRP+ fibre sprouting.
